rca_of_issue: Sign-date bug RCA: axon_lab.py PUT /lab/practices/{id}/sign only enforces format via a regex fullmatch, first mapping DD/MM/YYYY→YYYY-MM-DD then validating the resulting string with r'\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}'. That regex admits (a) requests already sent as ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' (bypassing the intended DD/MM/YYYY-only interface) and (b) impossible calendar days such as 31/02/2026 which get converted to '2026-02-31' and match the regex. Reproduction: `curl -X PUT .../lab/practices/{id}/sign -d '{"sign_date":"31/02/2026"}'` → 200. Fix: replace the regex validator with `datetime.strptime(sd_it, '%d/%m/%Y').date()` inside a try/except that raises HTTPException(400) on both format and calendar errors, and reject any input that is not DD/MM/YYYY (four-slash format explicit).
